reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 10 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged external-02 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-tab crop, full repair-agent white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; verified restored dark frame, removed paperclip, restored small dark right tab, exactly two note-mark rows, and rechecked cap, smile, uniform, collar, backing and transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The repair restores the complete DARK tilted photo frame rather than the prior pale border. The invented large upper-right paperclip is removed, and native inspection confirms the original small dark right-edge tab is restored in its original position/form. The note has exactly TWO compact upper gray-mark rows and mostly blank lower paper, with no third row. The light grey-olive cap retains its dark band, glossy visor, pale cord and two vertically separated silver-toned emblems; covered hair, dark brows, no facial hair and no glasses remain. The single open friendly smile with visible teeth, near-frontal three-quarter pose, chest-up crop and bright light under the visor remain. The dark grey-green tunic, light pointed shirt collar, dark tie and small pale collar/shoulder details remain, with a short broad fitted neck and no stalk or pinching. The pale warm grey-beige photographic backplate remains opaque. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior with no visible interior holes, missing backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha viewing; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed, and near-opacity values alone were not rejection grounds.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact cap-emblem interiors, tiny collar/shoulder insignia and note lettering cannot be read reliably at 65x67; the approval verifies visible frame color, hardware and tab shape, two-row footprint, portrait features and compositing rather than transcribing microscopic symbols or glyphs.
